title: Kharaqan Towers
source: Exact-QID site boundary plus two native tower footprints; ordinary whole/detail photographs.

reconstruction.scope: Specific paired Kharaqan mausoleums at one archaeological site: two separate mapped octagonal brick masses/rounded corner shafts, tall recessed pointed fields, original broad geometric brick relief and upper friezes, shallow curved brick caps with real lower slots. Distinguish the more ornate eastern panels from the western panels and restrained stabilizing struts. Small separate grade-seated brick footings; no platform across the gap or entire archaeological-site replacement. No copied inscriptions, image atlas, furnished tomb chambers or restored perfect sealed roofs.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Each native map shell reports15m height without a measured-point qualifier. Use nominal12m wall/corner-shaft height and3m curved cap rise. Relative frieze/panel/portal heights, shaft radii, outer cap slots, decorative schedule and west stabilizing-member assignment are picture-led visualization estimates. Preserve the documented roof openings; no perfect historical dome restoration or literal inscription inventory.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Original6m standard Mapzen grid, native paths/water and the one independent mapped utility/visitor building remain unchanged. Each tower has its own level floor just above the highest sampled occupied rim and a bounded buried footing below the lowest rim. No connecting precinct slab, ground/water cutout or flattened terrain. Coarse DEM/contact/plinth levels are visualization estimates, not surveyed archaeology or foundation engineering.
